an input to the memory cases

arms.asks: is the record a claim about main
arms.run: record it with NTS_BIN=<a clean main build> node tooling/conformance/outcomes-check.ts --record <name>

arms.asks: is the defect specific to what the fixture names
arms.run: a control differing in one thing, measured

arms.asks: does it agree on every backend -- by hand, because the differential reads the shared tree and cannot see an example not yet in it
arms.run: node tooling/differential/agree.mjs <after> --only=<example>   # and NTS_BACKEND=llvm, llvm+NTS_RC=1, jvm, NTS_RC=1

arms.asks: does it guard the change: it must not agree on the binary before
arms.run: node tooling/differential/agree.mjs <before> <after> --only=<example>

arms.asks: can a pinned gate see it
arms.run: commit it before a pinned gate run: a worktree gate cannot see an uncommitted example

arms.asks: does it catch what it guards
arms.run: its --self-test, and a sabotage arm: break the thing it guards and watch it fail, naming the thing

arms.asks: has every loop in it had input
arms.run: feed any list it loops over one entry, in a scratch copy, before relying on it

arms.asks: does a clean result mean it judged something
arms.run: print the population beside the verdict

arms.asks: does it work where it will be run
arms.run: run it from a worktree, and every mode it has: the one its author tests is the easy one
